correctness.rationale: Exact integer generation of all 8246 nonempty faces and 3508 verified elementary free-face collapses reduces the complex to a 3-dimensional CW complex with (19,171,558,482) face counts. Complete initial 2-skeleton implies simple connectivity. The exact signed 558-by-482 boundary has 404 rechecked unimodular unit pivots, and zero residual, so H2=Z, H3=Z^78 with no torsion. Hurewicz, Whitehead and classification of the 3-cell attachment degree matrix then prove the wedge homotopy type. Independent unreduced GF2 chain ranks agree. Signed Lefschetz traces checked for all 171 affine automorphisms yield H3-character 78,2,-3,0; character average gives quotient rational homology.
